summary: The proposed patch changes the behavior of the `String` class in `sympy.codegen.ast` by modifying the `not_in_args` attribute. While the tests pass, there are concerns about potential behavioral regressions and insufficient testing.

issues.description: Changing `not_in_args` from `['text']` to `[]` may break existing behavior that relies on the current implementation. This needs to be verified.

There are no additional tests provided to verify the new behavior of the `String` class. More tests should be added to ensure the change does not introduce regressions and meets the intended functionality.
